BSI Customer Suite
 
Europe’s Number One CRM/CX with AI by Design
Do you love your customers? So do we. Our AI-powered CRM/CX platform made in Europe will ensure that you attract customers, get them to engage with you and stay with you. Connect your sales, marketing, and service, keep your data safe, and benefit from our AI agents who can proactively assist you.
 
 
Assess BSI
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
We make industry leaders happy:
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
BSI Customer Suite
Boost your customer value with the most successful CRM/CX platform in your industry
Use concentrated&nbsp;
AI power
, delightful&nbsp;
customer journeys
, and exciting insights, shaping long-term&nbsp;
customer relationships
&nbsp;with the BSI Customer Suite from day one.
Explore the world of BSI
 
 
 
 
 
Intelligence
 
 
 
 
 
 
Do you still use prompts, or do you already know it?
 
 
You will recognize patterns, understand correlations, and draw real-time insights from your millions of customer data. Why? Because we have been working with agentic AI for a long time and integrated it deeply into BSI.
 
 
 
BSI Customer Suite products:
 
 
 
 
 
 
Artificial Intelligence
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer & Data Insights
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Processes
 
 
 
 
 
 
Your customers will feel as if they are at their neighborhood store
 
 
Communicate simultaneously with everybody and yet individually with each and every one – across all departments and channels. And as a result, turn all your customer journeys into unique experiences in no time.
 
 
 
BSI Customer Suite products:
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer Experience
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer Relationship Management
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer Engagement
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Data
 
 
 
 
 
 
Turn your data into relationships
 
 
Unify your company’s customer data, assure its quality, keep it GDPR compliant, and make it available to everyone. This lays the foundation for sustainable customer relationships.
 
 
 
BSI Customer Suite products:
 
 
 
 
 
 
Enterprise Integration Platform
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer Data Platform
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
The BSI promise
 
Customer first
 
Not only is BSI Software your 
only European alternative
 to US corporations – BSI is also the better software. Our CRM/CX solution is modular, AI-ready, and extensively customizable for your industry. You retain sovereignty over your data, use the specific Artificial Intelligence model that suits your business, and always remain flexible. And what if your business grows? Then BSI will simply grow with you.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Retain sovereignty
 
Your data, your rules: Maintain data sovereignty with BSI Software. Whether US hyperscaler or European provider, with us, you have the flexibility to switch out your 
cloud solution
 if your strategy requires it.
 
 
 
 
Have the freedom to choose
 
With BSI, you can choose from more than 70 
Artificial Intelligence
 models and use exactly the one that suits your needs. You want to switch? That is not a problem. We can do that for you in minutes.
 
Benefit from flexible scaling
 
Once the first choice, always the first choice: With the 
BSI Customer Suite
, you get continued stability and efficiency, even with a growing number of users, increasing amounts of data, and new requirements. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
We make things easy for you
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
BSI Customer World. The future of customer relationship.
 
BSI Customer World
 puts your customers at the center – across all touchpoints and channels. It combines marketing, sales and service in a shared AI-driven platform and intensifies your customer relationships in a targeted manner via customer values. Create a connected world in which data, automation and interactions work together. This makes your end customer Lena more valuable to you and you more valuable to her.
 
 
 
To BSI Customer World
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
BSI AI Agents. You give the direction, they deliver results.
 
With 
BSI AI Agents
, you control your customer processes at a strategic level – while specialized agents take care of the operational work for you. The result: scalable processes, less manual effort and a customer experience that is measurably better. 
 
 
 
To your AI agents
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
BSI Elements. Getting you started in no time
 
Turn the BSI Customer Suite into your customized business solution in an instant. For this purpose, 
BSI&nbsp;Elements
 puts a wealth of concentrated industry and product knowledge at your fingertips: all-encompassing use cases, high-performing processes, and smart configurations. With BSI Elements, you will simply get better faster.
 
 
 
Learn more
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Benefit from our extensive industry expertise
 
We are your Number One. No other vendor understands your market – Banking, Insurance & Health, Retail, Energy & Utilities – better than we do. Benefit from solutions and processes that comply with regulations and really suit you.

Discover our success stories
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
"The AI-powered solution approach exceeded our expectations. With the BSI Customer Suite, we can automate resource-intensive processes and personalize content at the same time."
 
 
Thorsten Schmelz
 
 
Head of Customer Service & Member of the Executive Board, Walbusch
 
 
 
 
 
"With BSI, we have repositioned our marketing automation: personalized, event- and score-based customer communication across several channels for more than 20 million customers and interested parties. The marketing department works independently in the cloud, with 3,000 agents involved. The focus is on efficiency, relevance and scalability.”
 
 
Erik Eichhorn
 
 
Product owner direct marketing – Marketing department, HUK-COBURG
 
 
 
 
 
"The BSI Customer Suite has impressed us with its comprehensive reporting, the opportunity to easily manage multi-level campaigns, and the almost unlimited options for activating new and existing customers."
 
 
Nicole Melson
 
 
Head of Existing Customer Marketing, Hanseatic Bank
 
 
 
 
 
"All the systems, interfaces, and the considerable number of teams involved have led to a high degree of complexity, which has been successfully managed by and with BSI. We can now manage customer inquiries and requests more efficiently, and our employees and customers benefit equally."
 
 
Timm Krieger
 
 
Head of Transformation at SIGNAL IDUNA
 
 
 
 
 
"Thanks to the seamless integration of our core banking system, BSI guarantees BLKB’s banking advisors a user-friendly front office workplace and facilitates individual and customer-oriented consultation."
 
 
Yannick Kunz
 
 
Project Manager, BLKB
 
 
 
 
 
"Trigger-based customer journeys with smaller, more refined target groups instead of budget-intensive marketing campaigns: In only two years, we reduced our material costs by 15%, and, with a target group size reduced by around 35%, increased our cross-selling and upselling rates by about 30%, and tripled this customer group’s premium volume."
 
 
Sven Zgraggen
 
 
Former Chapter Lead Customer Engagement at Baloise Insurance companies

BSI Customer Platform
Strong Foundation for Scalable Growth
 
Everything you need to put your customers at the center: our process platform for complete customer journeys and a broad ecosystem rich in valuable industry expertise.
 
 
 
Experience BSI
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Eco System
 
Enablement
 
 
Connect with BSI experts, partners, and peers. Use complementary products and services from the BSI ecosystem to enhance your customer processes and turn the gained expertise into genuine added value for your customers.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Partner Network
 
Become independent
 
We develop industry specialists and experts to address your challenges. Leverage the expertise, services, and features from the BSI ecosystem.
 
 
 
To the partner network
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
BSI Academy
 
From human to human
 
We turn you into a customer whisperer. You navigate the Customer World with ease, increasing your own value. Learn through exchanges with experts and peers, expand your knowledge and network, and master challenging learning paths.
 
 
 
To the BSI Academy
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Out of the box
 
Ready-to-use expertise
 
 
Don’t worry. BSI addresses your business and regulatory challenges with industry-specific solutions. And if you need a little more, BSI Elements provides you with additional use cases at the touch of a button.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Industry Cloud
 
You are part of a community
 
Get business out of the box – perfectly aligned with your region, industry processes, and regulatory requirements. Connect with like-minded people, share knowledge, and actively shape the BSI roadmap.
 
 
 
To our industries
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
BSI Elements
 
Business out of the box
 
With BSI Elements, you’re simpler, faster, better. Turn your BSI Customer Suite into your tailor-made business solution in record time. This means maximum value for your customers – and for you. BSI Elements delivers concentrated industry and product expertise: complete use cases, high-performance processes, and smart configurations. Ready-to-use business expertise in your tool – at the touch of a button.
 
 
 
To BSI Elements
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Fast software
 
Do you want full flexibility? Only BSI can give you that.
 
 
Simpler, faster, and more secure. Because our SaaS is cloud-agnostic and, our Adaption Platform gives you independence – and the ability to achieve maximum performance. Uncompromising scalability and efficiency.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Software as a Service
 
The only European alternative
 
You decide where to store and process all your data. Times, regulations, and risks may change – but you remain in control. Stay flexible, independent, and secure at all times, and keep full sovereignty over your costs.
 
 
 
More about BSI Software
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Adaption Platform
 
Maximum speed, maximum control
 
React quickly to new trends and implement your personal touch – all in record time. With our no-/low-code platform, you can configure your solution quickly and flexibly to meet individual needs without compromising on power. Thanks to the short time-to-market, you stay agile and always ready for release – effortlessly.
